test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 21 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘PIG’ is written as ‘49’ and ‘HAT’ is written as ‘52’. How will ‘CAB’ be written in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] The logic followed here is: **Sum of opposite letter's place value = Code.** ‘PIG’ is written as ‘49’
